L0_MLP.hypothesis: L0_MLP fuses the token embedding at its own position with outputs from L0 attention heads (which route BOS via L0H2/H3 and distribute prior-position info via L0H0/H1) into a non-binary arccosine-related signal, reading two or more distinct upstream sources; ablating all L0 attention heads (r4) changed L0_MLP's write by ~68% of its baseline magnitude, confirming it reads those heads as additional signals beyond the token embedding.
